pipeline.prompt: a modern compact crossover SUV, deep graphite metallic paint, smooth generic design, no badges, no logos, no licence plate, closed doors, standard alloy wheels, three-quarter front view from the front left at eye level, isolated product shot on a plain light grey seamless studio background, soft even diffuse lighting, no harsh reflections, whole car fully in frame with margin, sharp focus, photorealistic, orthographic-like long lens, no text, no people

pipeline.service: Tripo API (paid API credits; paid users hold all rights to outputs)

pipeline.tool: @gltf-transform/cli optimize --compress meshopt --simplify-ratio 0.5 (parts kept separate: --join false --flatten false)
